project.title: The Last Ferry
project.sourceIdea: At dawn, a courier must cross a flooded neon harbour on the final autonomous ferry to deliver a memory archive.

productionBible.logline: A courier races across a drowned neon harbour to deliver the last intact memory of a vanished family.
productionBible.synopsis: As the final autonomous ferry prepares to leave, Mina boards with a damaged memory archive and discovers that its only other passenger has orders to destroy it.

visualDirection.lighting: pre-dawn fog cut by ferry navigation lights
visualDirection.cameraLanguage: measured wides interrupted by intimate handheld close-ups

continuityRules: Mina always wears the red waterproof courier jacket.
The archive case has one cracked cyan status light.

characters.name: Mina
characters.goal: deliver the archive before the ferry reaches the outer checkpoint
characters.conflict: she cannot know whether the other passenger is an ally
characters.visualIdentity: young courier, cropped black hair, weathered red waterproof jacket, silver archive case
continuityRules: archive case stays in her left hand until scene 3

characters.name: Chen
characters.goal: verify and possibly destroy the archive
characters.conflict: his orders conflict with his personal memory of the family
characters.visualIdentity: older man, charcoal ferry uniform, brass identity badge, calm posture

locations.name: Flooded Harbour Terminal
locations.visualIdentity: half-submerged concrete terminal, cyan signs reflected in black water

locations.name: Autonomous Ferry Cabin
locations.visualIdentity: aged white composite cabin, fogged windows, red navigation glow

scenes.title: Last Boarding
scenes.purpose: establish the deadline and the archive

shots.camera: slow crane down toward the flooded platform
shots.action: Mina runs through ankle-deep water as the ferry doors begin to close.
shots.generationPrompt: Pre-dawn flooded Hong Kong-inspired harbour terminal, Mina in a wet red courier jacket running toward the last ferry, cyan emergency signs, grounded cyberpunk, cinematic wide shot.

shots.action: Mina sits opposite Chen and notices his brass badge.
shots.dialogue: CHEN: That case should not have survived.
shots.sound: hull vibration and rain on glass
shots.generationPrompt: Inside an old autonomous ferry cabin before dawn, wet red-jacket courier Mina opposite older uniformed Chen with brass badge, fogged windows, red navigation glow, tense medium two-shot.

warnings.message: Confirm which hand holds the archive after scene 2.
